en: is done for.
note: Completes #5919 (slice 073) 'A star actor who can't take the stage'.

en: But once my throat is fully healed,
Rex...
Wh-who's there? At this hour...
That's odd... My hotel room door
should've been locked.
Your beautiful voice is ruined...
Would you let me take a good look at your throat?
Are you a doctor or something?
I don't care who you are. If it can be cured,
I want it cured right away...
Wah! Wh-what are you doing?!
Eeeeek!!
From now on, take care not to hurt your face
as well as your throat.
For an actor, the face matters more than
anything, doesn't it?
If it serves your purpose,
I shall do anything at all.
Servant: "Normally we never let a stranger
into the mansion.
However, my master, Baron Marvin,
caught sight of you and instructed me
to show you in.
Please wait here a moment."
Welcome to my mansion.
I am Marvin. I am seventy years old now.
I've never wanted for money, so in my youth
I enjoyed gambling and a life of wandering,
but...
Naturally, I no longer have the stamina.
I think it's time I settled down in this
mansion for good, but
I can't decide what pleasure to live for
from now on, you see.
In that case, why not try a pastime loved by
the elderly, such as gardening?
Digging in the dirt, swapping old memories?
I'll pass.
Is there no more tasteful amusement?
It may not be much of a diversion, but
I shall come here to see you again,
Baron Marvin.
Please, do come.
You strike me as a man of taste yourself.
Servant: "The master has already retired
for the day.
Please come again another time."
How are you keeping, Baron Marvin?
How good of you to come.
My wife of a few years is often out, too,
so I was growing rather bored...
She is quite an amusing woman, mind you.
By the way, seeing you pass under my window,
I hit upon a splendid idea.
From tomorrow, I'll spend my days admiring
the lovely ladies who pass below my window.
Well? Quite a smart pastime, isn't it?
I do love the finer things, you see.
I have enjoyed every pleasure there is
since the day I was born.
And now I've found a new joy in watching
people go by from this window.
Admiring beautiful women... What greater
pleasure could old age hold?
Please, make yourself at home.
Guests like you are always welcome.
Good of you to come,
I have thought of another delightful idea.
This time, I'll pick out the loveliest ladies
passing my window and invite them here.
And I'll have them perform a Greek play.
They will be dressed as goddesses,
and I shall play the shepherd...
Well? A tasteful amusement, is it not?
Do you know the name of this play?
Beautiful ladies, carefully chosen...
And to the fairest goddess of all,
